name: 価格分布と予算の範囲指定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0009 価格分布と予算の範囲指定.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: input1 ORIGINAL Airbnb screenshot controls precise chart contour, slider-thumb geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment/spacing and fine control details. Relevant source region x71 y442 width1030 height722, Price range section ONLY. Input2 is rough localized mock, secondary authority for Japanese wording/currency values; its simplified histogram contour is inaccurate and must not replace the original distribution. Input3 bus is style only, never its map/content.
Exact Japanese copy: heading "料金の範囲"; supporting line "利用料金の目安を含みます"; lower-left label "最低料金" and value "￥ 2,000"; lower-right label "最高料金" and value "￥ 25,000". No other copy/numbers/metrics.
Reproduce ORIGINAL histogram shape faithfully: long near-empty initial baseline before bars begin, selected bars rise toward the thumb near the middle-left; the tallest light-gray bar stands immediately to the right of the selected maximum; then uneven gray distribution decays rightward with a distinct tall gray spike near the far-right edge. Preserve all original peaks/valleys, bar count and selected/unselected boundaries from input1. Do not copy input2's steadily rising-from-far-left stylized graph. No invented trend or chart axes/ticks.
Two original large white circular slider thumbs with fine neutral outline and restrained shadow sit on the baseline, first at left minimum, second around44%ofrange as in source. Active baseline connects them. Accent decision: original pink denotes SELECTED budget range; adapt only selected bars and active line to forest-green #1F6444 with restrained brand gradient depth. All unselected bars/baseline remain quiet neutral gray. Preserve this meaningful selection distinction, no other accent. Two white pill-shaped price fields under their labels, min left/max right.
Pure-white #FFFFFF canvas/card/input, rounded white card with fine neutral outline and soft subtle downward elevation. Japanese Meiryo heading Bold20/28, body Regular14/24, metadata labels12/16, price values Regular14/24; tracking0, no bold values/body. Natural compact spacing, aligned price fields, no clipping. Flat frontal high-resolution landscape4:3 with modest white margins. Exclude filter-sheet header/close, rooms/beds, amenities, footer buttons, app logos and device. Do not add features.
reviewNotes: 原参照をヒストグラムとスライダー細部の優先入力にし、モックの単純化グラフを不採用。左の空白区間、選択範囲後の最大灰色ピーク、右側の凹凸と端のピーク、白い2つまみを視認。原の選択ピンクだけ森林緑へ、非選択は灰色。日本語全文と￥2,000/￥25,000、白カードと欠けなしを確認。ビンの元データとピクセル単位の完全一致は未証明。静止画像エージェントレビューのみで所有者承認・編集可能性・実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
